lessons.title: Open the equipment picker

lessons.title: Open buddy commands

lessons.title: Equip binoculars
lessons.description: Equip the binoculars, then raise them to your eyes.

lessons.title: Put binoculars away
lessons.description: Put the binoculars away with the controls shown here.

lessons.title: Open Pause
lessons.description: Open the Pause menu. You can still look around and move your hands.
lessons.visual_finding: In the captured simulated pose, the Pause panel is visible and contained in the left eye, but is substantially clipped beyond the left edge of the right eye. Native Pause open/close predicates passed; the right-eye visibility failure remains open. This image alone does not establish a renderer-math defect.

lessons.title: Close Pause
lessons.description: Close the Pause menu to resume the game.

lessons.title: Rise to a crouch

reports.title: Stuck/distant cutscenes; OKB Zero helipad; prologue/jeep presentation (D/F/H)
acceptance: First-shot pin removed; current authored camera, head motion, cuts, Pause and return-to-player regressions pass. Complete multi-shot sequences and comfort still need runtime review.

reports.title: Mission 1, Ocelot binocular lesson cannot continue (D)
acceptance: Native script requires OnBinocularsMode/BINOCLE, which the custom VR optic does not establish. Implement the native state bridge, then complete on first playthrough without Skip or progression edits.

reports.title: Mission 6 bridge: displaced view, changed controls, cannot move (D)
acceptance: Capture before/after voice/script trigger and checkpoint reload; native controls and correct player camera survive.
reports.latest_report: September 27 follow-up: Coco reports three Mission 6 successes with two-second stale-state recovery. Another tester reports persistent frozen camera; earlier-build completion also reported. Candidate has not adopted this recovery. Progress/save/build conditions remain unresolved.

reports.title: Pause navigates invisibly during cutscenes (D)
acceptance: Open menu now takes input precedence over cinematic stick/trigger suppression. Both-eye menu visibility, return and allowed skip through cuts remain runtime acceptance cases.

reports.title: Black/third-person view near HMD, below waist, after idle/system menu; removal/resume crash (H/C)
acceptance: Prior fixes and contributor claims are partial evidence. Separate hand occlusion, HMD loss, focus/session loss and missing stereo publication.

reports.title: Changing game options drops VR until checkpoint reload (D)
acceptance: Change options/resolution and resume without losing chosen presentation or camera owner.

reports.title: C4 follows Snake's facing instead of player; mine/placement feedback (F)
acceptance: Native placement authority unverified. Physical/stick turn, recenter, tank placement, crouch/prone: preview and placed object agree.

reports.title: Clear-looking aim blocked near cover/prone; UI sound; rock behind player blocks shooting (D/F/H)
acceptance: Distinguish input rejection from native obstruction. Clear muzzle fires without stance reset; genuinely obstructed muzzle still blocks.

reports.title: Upper/lower body split, shadow mismatch, horse drift, box/toilet view after CQC/mounts/long play (D/F/H)
acceptance: Compare native root, displayed pelvis/torso and HMD across repeated transitions and a sustained session.

reports.title: Hands/weapons/items fade near surfaces; arms disappear near ground/prone (D/H)
acceptance: One fade hook exists. Identify first missing stage; verify both-eye visibility on slopes, walls and affected costume.

reports.title: Left hand jumps/detaches on pistol/revolver/Uzi, especially left roll (D/F)
acceptance: Current compact support logic is insufficient evidence. Sweep roll/close contacts, reload, release, reacquire and change weapons.

reports.title: Short arms, restricted reach, exposed/deformed sleeves (H/C)
acceptance: Measure shoulder/wrist/reach across users and costumes. No universal shoulder-offset fix is established.

reports.title: Low viewpoint, walking bob/sway, nausea; requested better height (D/F/H/C)
acceptance: Height setting exists and one user likes +20 cm. Check calibration, walk/run, stance/mount response and no accumulated offset.

reports.title: One-hand pitch; Quest -20 and G2 -16 fit reports; weapon-only pitch request (F/H)
acceptance: Aim correction exists. Verify controller/grip/aim, hand contact, sights and shot remain coherent; retain personal fit.

reports.title: Binocular/scope narrow eye range and intermittent lens disappearance; 15/16 cm boundary; scope jitter/smoothing request (D/F/H)
acceptance: New settings helped. Test physical tracking-safe distances, threshold hysteresis, smoothing/latency, both eyes, scopes and surrounding geometry.

reports.title: Weapon seems to switch near the face (F)
acceptance: Cause unknown: trace physical/chord/context/equipment events before attributing to optics distance.

reports.title: Pause at hip/bottom-left, unreachable; frozen arm while paused (D/H)
acceptance: Default quad helps some reports. Pause for >5 s; close/reopen; separately test opt-in handheld behavior and tracking.

reports.title: iDroid wide/squashed/tiny and desktop-aspect dependent; requests position/rotation/size (D/F)
acceptance: Partial tuning exists. Compare native canvas at 16:9, 16:10, ultrawide and non-16:9 custom render sizes; pan/zoom/tabs/clipping.
Raised right palm holds the native iDroid with its hologram upright and attached to the same device frame. Translate and rotate the hand; native skin and both final eyes must agree.
Snake remains stationary while both sticks navigate. Head and hands remain tracked. Verify native position, yaw, distinct sampled stick input, release and normal exit.
reports.latest_report: User requirement 2026-09-27: palm-held hologram like the introductory Ocelot demonstration; stationary Snake, tracked head/hands.

reports.title: iDroid tutorial needs D-pad; player stuck (F/H)
acceptance: Default menu D-pad actions are disabled. Complete requested tutorial inputs; independently verify safe escape/reopen.

reports.title: Controls editor Save becomes unavailable after remapping (F)
acceptance: Pending/invalid/error feedback repaired; hidden real-handler test passes valid save, rejected edit, correction, backups and external-edit preservation. Original attempted edit/checker identity still unknown.

reports.title: Thumb-rest mapping missing (F)
acceptance: Source plumbing now exposes separate left/right Touch-profile thumb-rest tokens through runtime sampling, parsing and binding export. Physical headset/profile acceptance remains open.

reports.title: Missing/conflicting controls; binocular stance differs; unclear controls/manual (D/H)
acceptance: Inventory effective actions by context/profile; test transitions, holds/chords, remapped controls and neutral live reload.

reports.title: Cannot toggle suppressor/flashlight in quick menu (D/H)
acceptance: Identify native action and provide usable conflict-free route with visible native state change.

reports.title: Carry/drop bodies, plants/diamonds/context actions and interrogation unclear/unusable (F/H)
acceptance: Instructions conflict across layouts. Test the active config's native hold/context actions and visible prompts; verify interrogation intel.

reports.title: Missing/intermittent world markers/highlights; unclear `full` (D/F/H)
acceptance: Mode-dependent visibility is intentional in source. Test mark/unmark and stow in each mode; trace any loss inconsistent with policy.

reports.title: Markers obscure enemy in `full` (F/H)
acceptance: Separate scale defect from R25. Bound apparent size near/far, world/binocular views and crowded scenes.

reports.title: Misaligned gun reticle; keep throw/placement reticle; laser too thin (D/F)
acceptance: Preserve useful aim feedback per action. Turning off all native reticles is not an acceptable workaround for placement.

reports.title: Missing ammo/flower/diamond icons, captions/prompts/notifications; blank loadout or detached HUD (D/H)
acceptance: Catalog missing native layers individually; prove each relevant pickup/message/loadout event in both eyes.

reports.title: No soldier stats through binoculars (D/H)
acceptance: Separate native analysis/progression availability from suppressed UI and from ordinary marking.

reports.title: NVG mesh blocks view (D)
acceptance: Hide only the offending first-person mesh where appropriate; retain NVG effect and equipment state.
reports.latest_report: September 27: Coco is still looking for the separate NVG mesh identity; no mesh fix is supplied.

reports.title: Tank/APC view fully obstructed (D)
acceptance: Choose vehicle-specific view/mesh treatment; test entry, motion, aiming, firing and exit without a global height hack.

reports.title: Mortar fires but cannot aim (D/H)
acceptance: Verify native targeting/range axes and reticle, with visible impact at intended target.

reports.title: Machine-gun turret lacks reticle/elevation (D/H)
acceptance: Both aim axes, firing, usable view and reticle, then exit.

reports.title: Helicopter/Pequod turret inaccessible (D/H)
acceptance: Verify native access/context action, traverse, elevation, fire and return.

reports.title: Combat-vehicle reticle absent; ZHUK RS-ZO range cannot change (D)
acceptance: Test this vehicle separately from ordinary tank/Jeep steering, including range and rocket impact.

reports.title: Cabin/cockpit bindings mixed; Continue selection/hidden-menu focus (D/H)
acceptance: Newer cabin/iDroid feedback is positive. Preserve cold launch, physical Continue, Resume and cabin controls without hidden menu movement.

reports.title: Vehicle auto-center on entry; view/steering/horse direction disagreement (D/H)
acceptance: Declare native mounted steering policy; no forced HMD turn or inherited on-foot snap offset on entry/exit.

reports.title: Xbox LT + shoot freezes into 2D presentation (F)
acceptance: Trace native aim/menu flags and owner; gamepad-only aiming/firing keeps live head tracking and intended display.

reports.title: Xbox binocular view floats at lower left (F)
acceptance: Provide centered native optic presentation when pad owns input; no requirement for tracked controllers.

reports.title: Resolution/sharpness, >4K startup, headset vs mirror FPS, optic/directional lag (F/H)
acceptance: Match runtime/resolution/refresh/route; measure fresh submitted frames and latency. Prior config/SIM results do not establish headset performance.

reports.title: Horizon artifacts/tree pop-in (D/H)
acceptance: Matched left/right motion capture; isolate culling/projection from resolution and frame cadence.

reports.title: Rectangular light/shadow mismatch; displaced flares/outline tails (D/H)
acceptance: Separate layers with same-frame stereo/projection evidence; do not group all artifacts as a pacing bug.

reports.title: Infinite Heaven/IHHook/SnakeBite coexistence (D/H)
acceptance: Versioned loader strategy and reversible install tests; preserve foreign loader. No claim of general mod compatibility.

reports.title: DLL/INI swaps start flat; folder/update/removal confusion (H)
acceptance: Show active game/config/build; complete-package install/update/rollback preserve personal settings, saves and unrelated files.

reports.title: ReShade/DLSS/other SnakeBite or graphics mods (H)
acceptance: Separate versioned combinations; do not infer support from one user's successful mod.

reports.title: Snap turn/angle/faster turning requested; recenter tilt history (D/H)
acceptance: Existing settings/source, not a missing implementation claim. Verify native smooth vs snap, angle, neutral latch and leaned pivot.

reports.title: Physical stand/crouch/prone (D/H)
acceptance: Explicit opt-in stance policy after height/native posture work; no double crouch or broken prone roll.

reports.title: NVG hand-to-head toggle (D)
acceptance: Deliberate gesture with hysteresis and no accidental equipment switch; R30 is a separate defect.

reports.title: Visible stance indicator (D/H)
acceptance: Native stance-derived, readable, consistent through scripted/mounted states.

reports.title: Enemy senses, subsistence, time/weather features from IH (D)
acceptance: Separate scope from loader coexistence and core VR recovery; preserve progression semantics.

reports.title: True left-handed rig (H: issue #8 at earlier review)
acceptance: Mirrored grip/weapon/interaction ownership and complete controls; not merely swapped button labels.

reports.title: Ground Zeroes first-person completion (H: issue #7 at earlier review)
acceptance: Separate camera/player/rig/HUD adapters and game-specific acceptance; TPP success does not close it.

reports.title: Quiet/rat/buddy expansion and universal mod installer (H)
acceptance: Separate native interaction/compatibility work. Retain existing working buddy behavior during regression checks.

reports.title: In-headset configuration instead of external editing (H)
acceptance: External editor already exists; an in-game editor needs safe input ownership, schema, persistence and readable UI.

reports.title: Roomscale/body movement and rotation follow the player (D/H)
acceptance: R07/R09 action-heading correctness comes first. Broader body-following needs native collision-aware movement, independent looking, stance/mount rules and observed arrival.
